name: BRAND TEXT
description: "DIAN CHIANG CHIA TECHNOLOGY (WUXI) CO., LTD, one of the largest manufactures in health and wellness industry, is dedicated in designing, manufacturing and selling series of far infrared Sauna Apparatus, sauna cabin and other health care products with the total investment over 10 million US dollars. Covering an area of 72,500m2, we own not only a garden factory but the experienced R & D team and the most advanced facilities. We devote ourselves to researching and developing far infrared product, especially the epoch-making Nano Carbon Heater technology. The test results approved by Center of the Chinese Far Infrared and Electric Heating Product Quality Surveillance Examines as well as Japanese Far Infrared Ray Applied Association indicate that the Nano Carbon Heater emits far infrared energy from 4 to 16 microns which is the ultimate wavelength rang for our body.With varies of fine characteristics such as ultra thin, large heating area, low surface temperature, safe & non-toxic, save electricity and durable and so forth, the Nano Carbon Heater has won patents in many countries over the world. With ETL, CE, TUV, cTUVus, PSE, C-tick, EK, TER and RoSH certificate and ISO9001 quality insurance, our products are well accepted by the distributors in Europe, America, Asia and Middle East. One of our agents is the sauna leader in the USA. Advanced technology paves the way for the first-rate products and favorable customer support brings high reputation. Deservedly, the artistic works of saunas manufactured by DCC has been well established worldwide. However, continuous effort is still being made to search after improvements and greater success. Our products include: Far infrared sauna Luxury Home Sauna Home Sauna Suite Commercial Sauna Sauna House Portable Sauna: HeatPad "
